statsPositionDesc.zh: 「收进上下文」把会话数字放进上下文圆环的弹层；「独立成行」写在输入卡片下面一行，末尾是圆环。
statsPositionDesc.en: Inside the context popover puts the session's figures in the ring's panel; On its own line writes them under the input card, ending in the ring.

statsComposerRequired.zh: 只在「重绘对话框」覆盖对话页时生效。
statsComposerRequired.en: Takes effect only while Composer restyle covers the conversation.
